lines.text: Closing time. One reader still at the terminals.
A second person comes in. They do not sign the book.
Something is handed over. Card 01611 is issued two minutes later.

content.text:
Rota, March. Mon: Pires. Tue: Pires. Wed: Costa (if she is better). Thu: Pires. Fri: whoever will. Sat: the volunteers. Sun: closed.

The sysop account is Pires’s and is also the building alarm code, since he could only remember one thing.

Donated papers, catalogued for the Lisbon Quarterly: 14 letters, one diary, one box of unlabelled slides. A researcher asked to see the slides and was told the box was mislaid. It was in the same drawer as last time.
